verzen.tekst: My father counts the days; and if I wait long, he will be very grieved.

verzen.tekst: So Raphael went on his way, and lodged with Gabael, and gave him the handwriting; so he brought forth the bags with their seals, and gave them to him.

verzen.tekst: Then they rose up early in the morning together, and came to the wedding feast. Tobias blessed his wife.
